invariant: A proof object must survive from admission to the actual effect and typed settlement; coordinates, configured intent, predecessor evidence, and surviving output shape cannot be re-derived as authority downstream.
global_constraints: Machine-readable repository state outranks narrative status prose.
A parent retires only after semantic exhaustiveness, not child count.
Green, review, and publication evidence never transfer across object versions.
Publication consumes runtime evidence; runtime does not depend on campaign ledgers.
Non-injective transforms retain both survivor identity and consumption proof.

constraints: Provider, verifier, event, and delivery identity are bound once by the domain spine.
HTTP and cryptographic authorities consume the bound namespace and exact raw body.
Session policy consumes the authenticated envelope without re-derivation.
Per-target terminal partial truth precedes documentation and final assembly.
Only the exact composed head may claim integration evidence.
Protocol-era discovery and OAuth metadata discovery remain orthogonal.
No second era selector, transport factory, provider cache, or credential authority.
Original contributor provenance must survive every extracted child.
Caller stamping and projection watermarking land as one proof-preserving system.
Durable and live candidates use the same repair/projection transform.
Provider and display serialization strip internal proof metadata.
The generic publication contract precedes channel ledgers.
Narrative counts are generated from or conformance-checked against committed ledgers.
Runtime implementation remains independent of publication validation.
Documentation follows executable composition and never defines runtime truth.
The terminal assembler is rebuilt from current main after all behavior owners publish.
Sibling tests are inputs, not substitutes for composed-object evidence.
Kernel-only surface is implementation evidence, not runtime delivery.
One immutable decision crosses admission and a real effect seam.
Concurrent tasks, stale generations, and approval or lease replay fail closed.
STT fallback never bypasses transcribe-only admission.
File-only transcript routing never leaks content into Discord.
Disabled agent turns never suppress transcript persistence.
The mutation actor cannot execute from mutable or native artifacts owned by the target generation.
Admission binds deployment root, source generation, target generation, and operation identity.
Settlement observes the admitted generation at the admitted root.
Arbitrarily named externally applied secret values are masked at provider egress.
Closure requires a current-main provider-wire witness bound to the exact head.
Historical partial implementations remain provenance, not closure evidence.
The 77xxx-79xxx population is campaign provenance, not an automatic rebase queue.
Only selected semantic slices receive active delivery authority.
Authorship and supersession remain explicit when implementation ownership converges.
